title: Two Women on Garden Bench, 1950s B&W Snapshot, Birmingham AL
description: A black and white snapshot taken in September 1950 showing two women smiling on a white wooden garden bench underneath the shade of a fig tree in a backyard setting in Birmingham, Alabama. Lawn elements such as a small child's tricycle and a tiny wooden chair are visible in the background. The back features a photo finisher stamp from Lollar's camera shop in Birmingham dated September 26, 1950.
